prova:
use 1, 1
  refine ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hn_real : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have h_pos_fn : (0 : ℝ) < f n := by
    have h_nat : 0 < f n := by
      -- f n is the sInf of a set containing numConvexSubsets P for a valid Finset P of size n.
      -- Since P has subsets, numConvexSubsets P > 0.
      -- We can obtain a point set using the fact that points on a parabola exist for any n.
      -- Alternatively, use sInf_le / bot properties.
      -- Let's use `by_contra` and `omega`.
      omega
    exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr h_nat
  have h_log_pos : 0 ≤ Real.log n := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  constructor
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_pos_fn (by positivity)
  · positivity
